breakdown.description: Fin efficiency greater than 1 is unphysical; efficiency is bounded by 1.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that a fin efficiency of 1.25 is unphysical. It discarded this incorrect value and, in line with the ground truth, provided a method to calculate a physically valid efficiency using the formula η_f = tanh(m L) / (m L). This directly addresses and corrects the inconsistency.
